instruction: I want to hear notification sounds so I don't miss important alerts. Please enable event sounds for notifications.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires enabling notification event sounds. The config disables event-sounds (false), and the agent must enable them (true). This is the inverse of variation 1, maintaining similar difficulty and using the same gsettings-based evaluation pattern.
metadata.verification:
Verified that gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.sound event-sounds returns 'true
' or 'false
'. The evaluator checks for 'true
' to confirm event sounds are enabled.
